projectDescription: An AI-native ERP platform where finance teams and AI agents collaborate on financial data — automating reconciliation, multi-entity consolidation, and continuous close for multi-country LATAM startups.
keyFeatures: AI Assistant (Erwin) — answers finance questions using your live data
Continuous Close — general ledger updated daily, month-end is a review not a rebuild
Automatic Reconciliation — bank movements matched to invoices, payroll, and accounting entries
Multi-Entity Management — manage all LATAM subsidiaries in one platform with intercompany eliminations
Multi-Currency Support — transaction, functional, and reporting currencies with daily FX rates
Revenue Recognition — contract-to-accrual automation integrated with HubSpot and PDF contracts
Financial Snapshot — live consolidated metrics: Cash, ARR, Burn, Runway, AP, AR
100+ Native Integrations — banks, payroll, expenses, CRMs, and payment processors
publicApiSurface: GET /transactions — query transactions by entity, date range, currency
POST /webhooks — register webhook endpoints for transaction and close events
